page0.text: I still have this weapon in my hand...!

page1.text:
Still suspended in the air, I swing with all my might using my other hand.
She must have known it was coming.
The Servant in black dodges in midair.
This grim reaper smirks.

page2.text:
"Khh...!"
I desperately swing my body to avoid it, but it's no use.
The Servant mercilessly thrusts the nail towards me right before my eyes.
She is shot from the side by numerous light bullets.

page3.text:
"Augh...!"
I fall to the ground.
The bullet cuts the chain, and I am unceremoniously dropped on my ass.

page4.text:
...
The Servant in black turns around.
She jumps to the tree branch and retreats like a beast.
